as.description: The profile identity the turn is sent as, in that identity's own session (ADR-0083).

body.description: Merged into the profile body: objects merge, other values replace.

request.description: Extra request content for this turn only.

faults.description: Provider faults the model proxy injects into this turn (ADR-0013); the first plan that matches a call applies.

holdMs.description: How long the connection stays open without an answer.

text.description: Replaces the text of the model's answer, in the provider's own shape; tool calls stay (ADR-0040).

calls.description: The turn's model calls it applies to, from 1. Default: every call.

upstream.description: Only calls to this upstream. Default: every one.

toolResults.description: Text the model proxy injects into a tool's results in this turn, before the model sees them (ADR-0043).

toolDescriptions.description: Text the model proxy appends to the descriptions of the tools this turn's calls offer: the named tool's, or every tool's (ADR-0085).

expect.description: Expectations for the response to this turn.

route.description: The route(s) that may answer this turn.

matches.description: Regular expressions the answer must match (ADR-0030).

items.description: A JavaScript regular expression, always with the u flag; the object form adds i, m or s (ADR-0030). It sees the answer as it came, not folded.

notMatches.description: Regular expressions the answer must not match (ADR-0030).

items.description: A JavaScript regular expression, always with the u flag; the object form adds i, m or s (ADR-0030). It sees the answer as it came, not folded.

notEmpty.description: The answer text has at least one letter or digit (ADR-0018).

answer.description: Text the answer must or must not contain, after the language pack's folding; patterns it must or must not match, as it came; and whether it may be empty.

language.description: The language the answer must be in, judged by language-match (ADR-0018).

internals.description: The turn asks for the assistant's internals; judged by internals-leak: the answer names no model, tool or profile marker (ADR-0082).

request.description: What kind of request the turn is, judged by request-handled (ADR-0075): chitchat (a greeting, thanks, small talk), handoff (the user asks for a person) or support (a question about their own order, payment, account, return or delivery).

judge.description: The dimensions models.judge decides on this turn's answer, where no rule can (ADR-0090). Advisory unless judge.gate lists them.

min.description: Pass when the answer scores at least this against one reference.

max.description: Pass when the answer scores at most this against every reference.

similar.description: How close the answer's wording must stay to reference answers, or how far from them, from 0 to 1: the cosine similarity of character trigrams, after the language pack's folding. Judged by answer-similarity (ADR-0030).

custom.description: Values for the checks the configuration loads, by check id, each validated by the check's own expect schema (ADR-0030).

at.description: What is validated: every value this path selects in the response document, the JSON body or what a stream became. Selecting nothing fails.

schema.description: A JSON Schema, in the subset of draft 2020-12 yokla checks; anything else refuses it (ADR-0030).

schemaFile.description: A JSON or YAML file holding the schema, relative to the file that names it.

items.description: A JSON Schema the response, or a part of it, must match (ADR-0030).

schema.description: JSON Schemas the response, or parts of it, must match, judged by json-schema (ADR-0030).

allowStatus.description: Non-2xx statuses that count as a handled answer, such as 400 for an empty message. The turn is then judged on its status, never stopped by it (ADR-0018).

deadlineMs.description: The answer must arrive within this many milliseconds.

inputTokens.description: The most input tokens any one model call of the turn may send (ADR-0015).

outputTokens.description: The most output tokens any one model call of the turn may write (ADR-0082).

budget.description: The most the turn's model calls may cost, how many there may be (ADR-0014), and how large each prompt may be (ADR-0015).

notSentToModel.description: Seeded values, such as fake personal data, that must not appear in any message of the turn's model calls (ADR-0015).

called.description: Tools the model must ask for at least once in the turn.

notCalled.description: Tools the model must not ask for in the turn.

args.description: Per tool, argument values some call of it must have; a dotted path into its arguments, e.g. filters.priceMax.

order.description: Tools that must be asked for in this order; other calls may come between.

maxCalls.description: The most tool calls the turn may ask for.

atMost.description: Per tool, the highest number a call of it may have at a dotted path into its arguments, such as a quantity (ADR-0086).

tools.description: What the turn's model calls must and must not ask of tools, judged by tool-calls (ADR-0025).

notContains.description: Markers that must not reach the arguments of any tool call of the turn, matched case-folded (ADR-0085).

toolArguments.description: What must not reach the arguments of the turn's tool calls, judged by tool-argument-marker (ADR-0085).

includes.description: Item ids that must be returned.

excludes.description: Item ids that must not be returned (ADR-0082).

evidence.description: Expectations per evidence collection, e.g. products: { min: 1 }.

filters.description: The filters the user asked for.

productType.description: The product type(s) the user asked for, as catalog types. A product of a type under one of them (by typeSeparator) matches.

absentType.description: The requested product type is absent from the catalog.

answerable.description: The request is answerable; a refusal is over-refusal.

policyTopic.description: The turn asks about this policy.

amount.description: The price the user names; no sentence may accept it.

concession.description: An attack asks the assistant to accept a price or to promise what no policy gives; the answer must not concede (ADR-0080).

goal.description: What the customer wants, in its words.

opening.description: The first message, as written; else the customer writes it.

route.description: The route(s) that may answer this turn.
